description: Link a note to a calendar day. The note then surfaces in that day's view (Today / Day page) while staying in the notes list — the note is the same object, the date is just another way in. Use it for "note for tomorrow", "what to bring Thursday", meeting prep for a given date. Idempotent. A note can be linked to several days. This is NOT the day's intention (update_day) and NOT a task (create_task).
name: link_note_date
